name: AIと書いていない方は、応募できません。(更新版・最新仕様)

p_17abb5c189.sentence: I thought AI was a helper working behind the scenes.
p_17abb5c189.next: Now it is openly the ticket to enter.

p_f67b19ede3.sentence: It may be too soon to say, “At last, we can compete to see how well AI can write.”
p_f67b19ede3.prev: If you have not used it, you cannot apply.
p_f67b19ede3.next: What I want to know is not about the writers.

p_cdc38d619f.sentence: I might ask AI to fix a phrase or help me think about what happens in the story.
p_cdc38d619f.prev: But when I think about being the writer, things become much harder.
p_cdc38d619f.next: But how much can I use it and still proudly say, “I wrote this”?

p_425ce3b0fa.sentence: Instead, it becomes the starting point for reading.
p_425ce3b0fa.prev: The question of whether AI was used does not end the discussion.
p_425ce3b0fa.next: It seems writers are not the only people being tested at this new entrance.

p_e4512d38ed.sentence: Using AI is not an extra benefit or a special case.
p_e4512d38ed.prev: It is for French stories that have not been published, written by a person and AI together.
p_e4512d38ed.next: If you have not used it, you cannot apply.

p_d66b185513.sentence: Imagine you are reading a story late at night.
p_d66b185513.prev: You could call it a question shaped like a trophy.

p_2e7aa1f006.sentence: I would not want to read it just because of that, either.
p_2e7aa1f006.prev: Of course, the label “co-written with AI” does not mean the story is interesting.
p_2e7aa1f006.next: I want to know what kind of story it is and how it is written.

p_489998b2f1.sentence: What if a literary prize had a rule like this for entry?
p_489998b2f1.prev: If You Didn’t Write with AI, You Can’t Apply
p_489998b2f1.next: Not “You may use AI,” but “You must write with AI.”

p_755268f1d1.sentence: It may be too soon to say, “At last, we can compete to see how well AI can write.”
p_755268f1d1.prev: If you have not used it, you cannot apply.
p_755268f1d1.next: What I want to know is not about the writers.

p_903571af48.sentence: Or would you say, “I enjoyed it, so I have no complaint”?
p_903571af48.prev: Would a line that seemed beautiful suddenly feel far away?
p_903571af48.next: A special meeting to judge the story might start inside your mind.

p_3966ebc671.sentence: Of course, the label “co-written with AI” does not mean the story is interesting.
p_3966ebc671.prev: A special meeting to judge the story might start inside your mind.
p_3966ebc671.next: I would not want to read it just because of that, either.

p_a63849d12e.sentence: Now it is openly the ticket to enter.
p_a63849d12e.prev: I thought AI was a helper working behind the scenes.
p_a63849d12e.next: The Prix Pascal was announced in France.
